name: Random Column Sampling for SVD Approximation
definition: A method to compute the first Ri left singular vectors of a wide matrix A (M << N) by applying SVD only to a randomly selected submatrix of columns, leveraging the fact that the column space is over-defined.
summary: Random Column Sampling for SVD Approximation computes left singular vectors by applying SVD to a randomly selected submatrix, offering simplicity and lower cost than Alternating MaxVol at the expense of optimal selection guarantees.
